messages:
jun: Quick status on NYC2: smoke passed but noticed an egress cost spike for some customers when the local pool hits capacity. Anyone tracking KMS provisioning for residency logs?
lia: I saw the spike too — looks like requests fall back to us-east whenever gpu-pool-nyc2 saturates :thinking_face: investigating routing-policy now.
adrian: I opened a PR to adjust route priority and add a canary flag — @lia can you review when free? https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4321
lia: on it, will take a look in the next hour.
sre-bot: smoke-tests: 5/5 checks passed. avg latency 84ms. observed egress cost delta +22% over 10m window.
ryan_ops: Confirmed pattern: when pool saturates traffic moves to proxy-A (us-east) which increases cross-region egress. Can we enable prefix caching or bump local route weight as a mitigation?
jun: Yeah — plan is prefix caching + bump route weight for local-edge. @devex-ella can you confirm this change won't alter customer-visible headers?
devex-ella: Confirmed — caching only affects internal routing headers. I'll update the playbook snippet and docs. I'll also ping Legal for residency wording.
adrian: FYI PR updated: added route-weight flag `edge-e2-weight=0.6` and canary toggle.
lia: LGTM on approach. small nit in comment, requesting 1-line change.
adrian: fixed and pushed. @jun can you approve rollout? proposed plan: canary 5% for 30m, then 50% if metrics look good.
jun: Approve. ops schedule canary at 21:00 UTC. Also we need a KMS key for nyc2-residency (product needs audit logs).
ryan_ops: Creating key and adding to vault now, ETA ~40m. will post ARN once done.
sre-bot: vault-write successful: nyc2/kms/arn=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-REDACTED — see ops-runbook for rotation policies.
lia: Noted dependency: legal review on the residency doc still open — @maria can you take?
maria: On it, will complete review by EOD today.
jun: Great. I'll update the region playbook, tag owners, and add the canary checklist. Next checkpoint tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
adrian: :thumbsup:
jun: deploy-cli rollout --region nyc2 --canary 5 --flag edge-e2-weight=0.6 (will run at 21:00 UTC as planned)
